title: Primary: after 3 short-family stops in a day (RW3-FD/RW5-FD/MF2-FD/MF4/MF4-FD), new short-family lots at half size (every trade kept)
hypothesis: A day whose short-family stops pile up early keeps going wrong for that family, so halving later family lots cuts the tail without cutting trades.
notes: Two-year open history, costs in, Primary's 8 setups with ST-P modelled (base): CVaR5 -39.4 -> -29.1R/day, max DD 1704 -> 1273R, worst day -69 -> -40R, total R -1467 -> -1025, R per unit risk -0.059 -> -0.054, red days 262 -> 268 of 426. BUT vs shrinking every trade by the same average (uniform control, mean weight 0.77): train t -0.36, valid t +2.01 -> no proven selection; the 2-stop sibling's one locked look FAILED vs its uniform control (t -0.86, R/risk -0.139 vs -0.130). Live paper (current-8, 16 sessions 10-08..10-29): total +84.0 -> +85.8R, +$1,568 -> +$1,728, 10-29 -11.3 -> -8.5R (-$411 -> -$257), 10-22 unchanged; 29 trades affected (12%). Other accounts (T1/T2/Graveyard/Gen, ~9.7k trades): shorts after 3 short stops are not worse than other shorts -> no persistence evidence. Configs tried in lineage: 68 (bar 2.91). Owner decision as a risk control (ST-P precedent); not a proven edge.

title: Primary: lots taken on the same symbol+side in the same poll share 1R (w = 1/k), every trade kept
hypothesis: Two or three setups firing on the same bar on the same name are one bet; sizing them at 1/k caps that bet at 1R.
notes: Two-year (ST-P base): total R -1467 -> -1204, CVaR5 -39.4 -> -34.8 - no better than shrinking every trade by the same average (vs uniform: train t +0.53, valid t -0.30, worst-days t -1.39). Live paper current-8: +84.0 -> +63.2R (-25%), because same-poll doubles were the best live trades (10-22). 10-29 -11.3 -> -9.1R. Later-lot half / harmonic / profit-gated stacking (W2-W6) and blocks (B5 one family lot per symbol per day, B6 later lot only if the first is >= +0.25R) behave the same: variance cut = P/L cut. Failed the owner's no-P/L-cost condition.

title: Primary: no same-symbol re-entry within 60 min after another lot exited at target
hypothesis: A late re-entry after the move has paid (IOVA 10-29, -1.10R / -$104) is chasing an exhausted move.
notes: Two-year train: re-entries after a same-symbol target are BETTER than average (n 204, -0.09R base vs +0.00..+0.18R); B7 changes total R by +0.01R/day (t 0.24). Failed.

title: RW3-FD / RW5-FD / MF4: half size (or skip) a short when the stock is already above today's open on a gap-down day (gap filled)
hypothesis: NTSK 10-29: three shorts at 13:00 at +3.3% above the open on a gap-down name that closed +4.5%; fading a filled gap fights a trend day.
notes: Tested as R4a-d (size and skip, ST-P base): no better than a uniform shrink (vs U train t -0.02, valid t -1.06; skip R/risk -0.066 vs -0.059). Failed. Original note: untested (needs the lab frames' open/from-open features in the signal cache). Test with the size version first (keeps trades), pre-declared grid on train, uniform-shrink control, ST-P base.

title: Primary short family: half size when breadth_open (share of universe above its open) >= 0.55/0.60/0.65 at the decision bar
hypothesis: 10-29 was an up session for the universe (median +0.48%) while QQQ fell; the family loses -0.22R/trade in up sessions on two years.
notes: Two-year, ST-P base: total R -1467 -> -1164/-1256/-1382, but vs the uniform shrink on the worst-5% days t -0.88/-0.46/-0.19 (train t +0.63/+0.10/-0.72, valid +0.44/+0.79/+0.29).
